title: Senior Tax Technology Consultant
content: Engineered ETL pipelines using Python, SQL, and Alteryx to ingest and transform large client datasets, feeding automated reporting workflows and interactive Power BI dashboards that replaced manual processes.

Deployed an AI-driven invoice agent that identifies eligible invoices from client AP data, triggers automated retrieval through a Power Automate bot, and applies LLM-based classification to assign commodity codes and determine process eligibility based on line-item descriptions, eliminating hours of manual effort per month.
Integrated client Vertex and ONESOURCE tax engine instances with EY's platform via API connectivity, automating rate and taxability determination across millions of transactions per month.
Embedded multi-stage approval workflows and control-total validation into monthly processes, giving reviewers step-level approval checkpoints and a defensible audit trail.

title: Staff Tax Technology Consultant
content: Led product definition for a platform integration between two internal systems, authoring user stories and detailed requirements, building UI mockups in Figma, and executing business testing.
Owned onboarding and configuration of 80+ clients onto an internal SaaS platform, delivering tailored solutions that streamlined day-to-day workflows for both client and engagement teams.
Authored comprehensive technical documentation, including business and data requirements, process flow diagrams, and end-user guides, enabling smooth adoption of new tools across distributed teams.
